chunks: We gave David and Solomon knowledge; and they said: 'All praise be to God who has favoured us over many of His creatures who believe.'
ai.seo_question: What did David and Solomon say after receiving knowledge from God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the unique spiritual and intellectual station of the Prophets, particularly David and Solomon, whose knowledge is viewed as a divine bestowal rather than mere acquired learning. Their immediate gratitude highlights the principle that true superiority among the faithful is rooted solely in God's grace, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the infallible Imams inheriting this prophetic light. This acknowledgment serves as a model for believers to recognize their own blessings as gifts from the Divine rather than personal merit.
